claims: As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy's net worth is estimated to be between $250 million and $350 million.
Sunday Times Rich List (2026) estimated Rory McIlroy's net worth at roughly $350 million (£225m+).
In April 2025, Rory McIlroy became only the second golfer in PGA Tour history after Tiger Woods to surpass $100 million in career earnings.
As of April 2026, Rory McIlroy's official PGA Tour earnings are over $110 million.
Rory McIlroy won The Masters in 2025.
Rory McIlroy completed a career Grand Slam in 2025.
Rory McIlroy won The Players Championship in 2025.
Rory McIlroy has partnerships with Nike, TaylorMade, Omega, and UnitedHealth Group.
Rory McIlroy has invested in Whoop through his company Symphony Ventures.
Rory McIlroy has invested in Troon through his company Symphony Ventures.
Rory McIlroy made a $250m investment in TickPick through his company Symphony Ventures.
Rory McIlroy has benefited from the Player Impact Program (PIP).
In 2024, Rory McIlroy was reportedly awarded $50 million in equity from PGA Tour Enterprises.
Rory McIlroy is consistently ranked behind only Jon Rahm and Tiger Woods on various highest-paid golfer lists.
